Agent Platform Enhancements
Agent platform enhancements provide real-time visibility and elevate service levels agents can offer to students and their families
As part of our comprehensive receivables solution, these enhancements will help agents better manage student information and streamline payment tracking while also enabling education institutions to optimize agent relationships and minimize potential fraud. More updates for you! Join Flywire & AIRC <[[https://us02web.zoom.us/webinar/register/WN_8q0ROnm-S2C-MQYqFGxd9g?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]> on July 30th at 9 AM EST In this informative webinar, we’ll share real-world examples, flexible solutions and best practices to aid your international student recruitment strategies through agents. <[[https://us02web.zoom.us/webinar/register/WN_8q0ROnm-S2C-MQYqFGxd9g?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]> S.O.S. Survey Results Blog We surveyed higher education institutions and current international students to learn more about COVID-19’s impact and our newest blog will reveal the results! <[[https://www.flywire.com/resources/save-overseas-studies-covid-19s-impact-on-students-institutions-and-the-economy?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]> Flywire Charitable Foundation The foundation is launching four scholarships <[[https://bit.ly/2NtEjra]]> that will be awarded to students in two distinct academic categories: global health and medicine, as well as social justice. We would love to have you share our scholarship application page with your students. International Payment Plans Now Available Flywire is thrilled to expand our Payment Plan offering to now support international payment methods for students and institutions worldwide!
Why offer Flywire’s payment plans to your international students?
- 50% increase in plan enrollment - 24x7 self-service account access - 40% reduction in call volume
If you haven't already seen Flywire's international payment plans in action, you can do so in our "Delivering with Confidence: International Payment Plans" webinar, which is now available on-demand. <[[https://www.flywire.com/resources/on-demand-webinar-delivering-with-confidence-international-payment-plans?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]> Helping you deliver on
